# Sisu@UT

> Sisu@UT is University of Tartu's WordPress Multisite platform for e-learning, digital scholarship, and institutional content management across multiple faculties.

Sisu@UT serves as the central hub for University of Tartu's digital presence, hosting faculty portals, e-learning resources, and research initiatives. The platform supports website creation, content management, and academic collaboration through a unified WordPress Multisite infrastructure with SSO authentication.

## Getting Started

- [Avaleht | Sisu@UT](https://sisu.ut.ee): Homepage for Sisu@UT, University of Tartu's WordPress Multisite platform
- [Sisu@UT – Juhendid e-õppe kasutamiseks](https://sisu.ut.ee/juhendid/sisuut): User guide for Sisu@UT e-learning platform and website creation
- [WordPress Multisite'i ülekantud lehestike korrastamine – Juhendid e-õppe kasutamiseks](https://sisu.ut.ee/juhendid/WP-korrastamine): Guide for organizing migrated WordPress Multisite pages and setup

## Faculty Portals

- [Humaniora | Sisu@UT](https://sisu.ut.ee/humaniora): Humanities faculty portal featuring digital scholarship and research centers
- [Socialia | Sisu@UT](https://sisu.ut.ee/socialia): Social sciences faculty portal with research units and academic programs
- [Medicina | Sisu@UT](https://sisu.ut.ee/medicina): Medicine faculty portal with research centers and medical education resources
- [Realia et naturalia | Sisu@UT](https://sisu.ut.ee/realia-et-naturalia): Science faculty portal featuring environmental research and projects

## University Resources

- [Varia | Sisu@UT](https://sisu.ut.ee/varia): Miscellaneous university resources, events, and research groups portal

## Optional
